# Stone Works Remodeling
> Metro Detroit's trusted bathroom remodeling contractor — licensed, insured, and backed by a 5-year workmanship warranty.

## About
Stone Works Remodeling is a licensed and insured bathroom remodeling company based in Livonia, MI, serving Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb Counties across Metro Detroit since 2009. The company is led by Valjon Qejvani and specializes in full bathroom renovations, tub-to-shower conversions, walk-in tub installations, and custom stone and tile work.

## Contact

- Hours: Monday–Friday 8am–6pm, Saturday 9am–2pm

## Services
- Complete bathroom remodeling (full renovations, custom tile, vanities, plumbing)
- Tub-to-shower conversion (remove bathtub, install walk-in shower with custom tile and glass)
- Walk-in tub installation (accessible, safety-focused tubs for seniors and mobility needs)
- Tub replacement (modern bathtub upgrades)
- Custom stone and tile work (marble, slate, quartzite, granite, travertine)
- Shower remodeling (tile, glass enclosures, niches, benches)

## Service Area
Wayne County: Detroit, Livonia, Dearborn, Westland, Canton, Dearborn Heights, Taylor
Oakland County: Troy, Royal Oak, Birmingham, Bloomfield Hills, Farmington Hills, Novi, Rochester, West Bloomfield, Pontiac
Macomb County: Warren, Sterling Heights, Shelby Township, Macomb Township
